song_craft: Voice: stotra couplets, one work-voice across fifteen rasa-colors (adbhuta→vīra→śṛṅgāra→ānanda→śānta — the work walks the rasas home to peace). Each verse hammer-tight in L3: L4 = L3 verbatim throughout, music named per verse. Arc: all-containing light (v1) → aloneness (v2) → inseparables (v3) → mirror-bearing (v4) → exact fullness (v5) → play at once (v6) → five-in-one (v7) → criterion (v8) → abiding change (v9) → total inventory (v10) → bondage named (v11) → open doors (v12) → release (v13) → non-difference (v14) → dwelling enjoined (v15).

lines: Light never setting — bright powers, darknesses, all;
one, within, in whom each shine and shadow fall.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anastamitabhārūpas tejasāṃ tamasām api | ya eko 'ntar yadantaś ca tejāṃsi ca tamāṃsi ca

verses.craft: Unsetting light; yadantaḥ double-kept (limit+abode both: within…in whom) per UNC held-open; end-weight fall (setting never, falling ever).
verses.rejected: (a) resolving limit-vs-abode → killed by UNC. (b) shadows→darknesses flatten → killed: L3 keeps both bright-powers/darknesses (L2).
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa adbhuta of all-containing light / L2+L3 voice
